scientific_integrity: Proof uses exact autocorrelation and a global nonnegative identity; finite checks are supplementary, not an extrapolation. No claim of publication priority or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Six frequencies forming the full 3-by-2 rectangular set, all six coefficients of unit modulus; general compact-group formulation requires 15 distinct relevant characters. Does not optimize arbitrary magnitudes, other array shapes, or complementary pairs. Older polyphase catalogs could contain an equivalent result. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact fourth-moment range and all phase orbits of a six-mode Fourier rectangle
